name: v65_ffoa_guidance_improvement
hypothesis: Adjusted funds-from-operations guidance may capture a real-estate/cash-earning expectation channel that is distinct from reported FCF/equity and shareholder-equity guidance.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_maxguidance) / (2 * cap), 63), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_maxguidance) / (2 * cap), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_minguidance) / abs(cap), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Primary fresh guidance probe; reject if it maps to reported FCF or sh-equity guidance actives.

name: v65_ffoa_guidance_subindustry
hypothesis: Subindustry peer-ranking may isolate FFOA guidance against more comparable firms and reduce broad analyst-expectation correlation.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_maxguidance) / (2 * cap), 63), 126), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_maxguidance) / (2 * cap), 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_minguidance) / abs(cap), 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Peer-axis sibling only; do not rescue further if both FFOA variants fail or correlate.

name: v65_qf_ffo_guidance_improvement
hypothesis: Quarterly FFO guidance may shift timing away from annual cash-profitability factors while preserving cash-earnings guidance information.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_ffo_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_ffo_maxguidance) / (2 * cap), 63), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_ffo_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_ffo_maxguidance) / (2 * cap), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_ffo_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_qf_nd_ffo_minguidance) / abs(cap), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Quarterly FFO timing test; strict correlation gate against P0pgZllw, 9qwWXNW9, and O0p8JGJq.

name: v65_ffoa_cfo_guidance_mix
hypothesis: FFOA guidance may need a small CFO-guidance confirmation term to avoid being too narrow, while still keeping CFO below a supporting weight because prior CFO-only probes were weak.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_maxguidance) / (2 * cap), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_ffoa_maxguidance) / (2 * cap), 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfo_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfo_maxguidance) / (2 * cap), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: CFO is capped at 20% because CFO actual/guidance was weak in v37/v50/v56.
